_note: THE THREE JUNIOR PROGRAMMES, and the seats they lead to.
f2_team is the Formula 2 entrant the programme BACKS - which is how junior
academies actually work, and is deliberately not a claim that one team owns
another. The 2019 affiliations are the real ones as far as they go: Ferrari
placed its academy drivers at Prema, Red Bull has run juniors at Carlin for
years, and ART is the traditional Mercedes-adjacent seat. Two of the three
are approximations rather than contracts, which the disclaimer already
covers - this is a dramatisation of a career, not a claim about anybody's
f1_seat is the driver whose car he takes, and f1_lead is the man he then
races alongside. ALWAYS THE SECOND SEAT: he is the junior arrival next to
an established number one, which is both how it works and what gives the
booth somebody to measure him against for years.
The names are the ones the F1 2021 mod reports in the user's own result
files, so the seat he is told to load is a car that exists on his disk.
IF THE F2 MOD NAMES ITS TEAMS DIFFERENTLY, f2_team is the field to fix -
it is checked against the mod after the first F2 race.

ferrari.name: the Ferrari Driver Academy
ferrari.tone: the most watched junior programme in the sport, and the least patient

red_bull.name: the Red Bull Junior Team
red_bull.tone: a programme that promotes early and drops early, and makes no secret of either

mercedes.name: the Mercedes junior programme
mercedes.tone: slow to promise anything and slower still to go back on it
